profile.name: SR830 锁相放大器
profile.description: 用于相敏检测的数字锁相放大器。该设备可提供内部参考正弦输出，配置输入模式、灵敏度、时间常数、滤波与储存参数，并读取测量值、辅助模拟量和缓冲区数据，常用于弱信号与噪声环境下的精密测量。
profile.description_en: A digital lock-in amplifier for phase-sensitive detection. It can provide an internal sine reference, configure input mode, sensitivity, time constant, filtering, and storage settings, and read measured values, auxiliary analog signals, and buffered data for precision weak-signal measurements in noisy experiments.
